feed.title: Ripple / 涟漪
feed.subtitle: Guides and comparisons from the developer of Ripple, a free app blocker for Android and iPhone, for adults and for parents.

entry.title: All Ripple comparisons on one page: app blockers and parental controls for Android and iPhone
entry.summary: Every comparison between Ripple and other app blockers, focus apps and parental controls, grouped by built in tools, limiting your own phone, limiting a child's phone and apps popular in China.

entry.title: 涟漪全部对比页：限制 App 和家长控制 App 怎么选
entry.summary: 涟漪和其他限制 App、专注 App、家长控制 App 的对比页都在这一页，按手机自带工具、国内常见、大人管自己、家长管孩子分组。

entry.title: Ripple vs Zenze and Mobicip: a free app blocker or a paid parental control
entry.summary: Zenze is a free Android blocker with ads, a score and leaderboards. Mobicip is a paid parental control with remote management, filtering and location on iPhone and Android. Ripple is free with no account and gives each app a plain daily cap, with an unlock code someone else can keep.

entry.title: 涟漪、Zenze 和 Mobicip 怎么选：免费限制 App 还是付费家长控制
entry.summary: Zenze 是有广告、分数和排行榜的免费安卓限制 App。Mobicip 是按年付费的家长控制，能远程管理、过滤网站和定位。涟漪免费不用注册，给每个 App 设简单的每日时长，解锁码可以交给别人保管。

entry.title: Ripple vs Bu Zuo Shou Ji Kong and Tomato ToDo: Chinese focus apps compared
entry.summary: Tomato ToDo is best for timed study sessions and study rooms. Bu Zuo Shou Ji Kong gives the most control on Android, with many settings and a membership. Ripple is free with no account and gives each app a plain daily cap, with an unlock code someone else can keep.

entry.title: 涟漪、不做手机控和番茄ToDo怎么选：大人管自己和家长管孩子
entry.summary: 番茄ToDo 适合按番茄钟学习和进自习室，不做手机控在安卓上管得最细但设置多、有会员。涟漪免费不用注册，给每个 App 设简单的每日时长，解锁码可以交给别人保管。

entry.title: Ripple vs Microsoft Family Safety: app limits for parents and adults
entry.summary: Microsoft Family Safety limits apps and games across Windows, Xbox and Android for families with Microsoft accounts, but does not limit apps on an iPhone. Ripple is free with no account and sets hard per app limits on one Android phone, with an unlock code someone else can keep.

entry.title: 涟漪和微软家庭安全怎么选：家长管孩子和大人管自己
entry.summary: 微软家庭安全能让游戏和应用时长在 Windows、Xbox 和安卓之间合计，但限制不了 iPhone 上的 App。涟漪免费不用注册，在一台安卓手机上按 App 设硬上限，解锁码可以交给别人保管。

entry.title: Ripple vs TimeLimit.io and DetoxDroid: free app limits on Android
entry.summary: TimeLimit.io is open source parental control with child profiles and a connected mode. DetoxDroid is an open source detox app with grayscale and doom scrolling breaks. Ripple is free with no account but not open source, and sets hard per app limits with an unlock code someone else can keep.

entry.title: 涟漪和 TimeLimit.io、DetoxDroid 怎么选：安卓免费限制 App
entry.summary: TimeLimit.io 是开源家长管控，能建多个孩子用户和联网管理。DetoxDroid 是开源数字排毒 App，有黑白屏和打断刷屏。涟漪免费不用注册但不开源，按 App 设硬上限，解锁码可以交给别人保管。

entry.title: Ripple vs OurPact and Norton Family: phone limits for parents and adults
entry.summary: OurPact and Norton Family are paid parental control services with remote rules, monitoring and location. Ripple is free with no account and sets per app limits on the phone itself, for a child's phone you can set up in person or for your own. OurPact skips Xiaomi, Oppo, Honor and OnePlus phones.

entry.title: 涟漪和 OurPact、Norton Family 怎么选：家长管孩子手机和大人管自己
entry.summary: OurPact 和 Norton Family 是付费家长管控服务，能远程改规则、监控和定位。涟漪免费不用注册，在手机上按 App 设时长，适合能当面设置的孩子手机，也适合自己用。OurPact 不支持小米、OPPO、荣耀、一加。

entry.title: Ripple vs FocusMe and BlockerX: strict app blockers compared
entry.summary: FocusMe has strict plans and computer sync, BlockerX filters adult content and tells a partner about uninstalls, Ripple sets free per app limits on Android with an unlock code. For adults who keep turning their blocker off and for parents.

entry.title: 涟漪和 FocusMe、BlockerX 怎么选：难以绕过的 App 限制对比
entry.summary: FocusMe 计划可以设得很严还能和电脑同步，BlockerX 过滤成人内容并在卸载时通知伙伴，涟漪在安卓上免费按 App 设限制，用解锁码管住放松。写给总关掉限制的大人，也写给家长。

entry.title: Ripple vs Flipd and SPACE: study timer, habit tracker or app blocker
entry.summary: Flipd times study sessions and locks apps while one runs, SPACE tracks screen time and unlocks. Ripple sets rules that stay on all day, for adults studying or working and for parents setting homework time on a child's phone.

entry.title: 涟漪和 Flipd、SPACE 怎么选：学习计时、习惯记录还是 App 限制
entry.summary: Flipd 计时期间锁 App，SPACE 记录屏幕时间和解锁次数，涟漪设整天有效的规则。写给考试季的大人，也写给给孩子设写作业时段的家长。

entry.title: Ripple vs Kidslox and FamiSafe
entry.summary: Paid parental control with remote management and monitoring, or a free app blocker with no account, for parents and for adults.

entry.title: 涟漪和 Kidslox、FamiSafe 怎么选
entry.summary: 带监控的付费家长控制，还是不用注册的免费 App 限制，写给家长和大人自己。

entry.title: Ripple vs Olauncher and minimalist phone
entry.summary: Minimalist launchers hide icons, an app blocker sets limits. What each does for adults and on a child's phone.

entry.title: Ripple vs YourHour and Regain
entry.summary: Floating timers, Reels blocking and Pro plans compared with a free Android app blocker with daily limits and an unlock code.
